messages:
tom.evans: Hey, after upgrading to @redwood/sdk v0.30 our production jobs started getting 404s for chat.create and summarize routes. Spikes in retries/billing. Can someone look?

marta.support: Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste the minimal repro and the exact SDK version from package.json? Also any error body you see.

tom.evans: package.json shows \"@redwood/sdk\": \"^0.30.0\"
Node 18.16.0, running in our serverless workers. Error body from logs: `{"error":{"message":"route not found: /v1/chat.create","code":"not_found"}}`

sasha.devex: Thanks. A few customers hit similar after 0.30.0. We shipped a route key normalization that renamed some endpoints (internals) — should be backward compatible but looks like a bug. Can you share the exact client call?

tom.evans: Minimal call: ```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-large', messages: [{role:'user', content:'hi'}], session: 'sess-123' });
```
It fails with 404. If I downgrade to 0.29.7 it works immediately.

marta.support: Noted. Two hypotheses: 1) param rename (`session` -> `session_id`) in the new client, 2) the client changed internal route mapping for chat.create -> chat.completions (server expects legacy). Can you try using the `chat.completions` shim (if available) or explicit `session_id` field?

tom.evans: Tried `session_id` in the body, still 404. Logs show client POST to `/v1/chat/create` (note the slash) instead of `/v1/chat.create` — looks like a dot-vs-slash conversion bug when building route string.

alex.eng: jumping in — good catch. We introduced a path builder that accidentally converts dots to slashes for some composite routes when `routeMapping: 'auto'`. That would POST to a non-existent path and produce the 404. We have a patch branch. Workarounds: 1) pin to 0.29.x, 2) set env `RW_SDK_ROUTE_LEGACY=true` to force legacy mapping, or 3) monkeypatch the request path before send: ```js
client._sender = (req) => fetch(req.url.replace('/v1/chat/create','/v1/chat.create'), req); // temp
```

alex.eng: We're cutting 0.30.1 now to revert the conversion. ETA ~1 hour for npm publish, will also add telemetry to detect affected calls.

marta.support: For customers seeing billing spikes we recommend rate-limiting retries. The SDK had a built-in exponential retry that kept replaying on 404 in some configs (bug). Set `maxRetries: 0` in the client as a safeguard until patch lands. Example: `new RedwoodClient({ apiKey, maxRetries: 0 })`.

tom.evans: Confirmed downgrade to 0.29.7 stops the 404s and billing noise. I applied `maxRetries: 0` as well. Can you notify when 0.30.1 is published so we can try again?

deploy-bot: npm package @redwood/sdk@0.30.1 published to registry (staging), tarball available.

alex.eng: Thanks — we've published 0.30.1 to public registry, it reverts the route conversion and fixes the retry-on-404 logic. Changelog: "fix(route-mapping): preserve dot-form routes; fix(retries): don't retry 404s by default". Patch also adds a telemetry flag to track wavelength of affected keys.

tom.evans: Installed 0.30.1, smoke tests pass, no 404s. Thanks for the quick fix.

marta.support: Closing the thread once you confirm stable for 24h — we'll follow up with a postmortem and release notes. If you want a backport to our enterprise pinned build let us know. :thumbsup:
